review.imagery: Fifteen project renders were visually reviewed. Thirteen native brochure scenes cover exterior, pool detail, two living/dining views, lobby, bedroom, bathroom, evening pool, amenity aerial, outdoor gym, lounge, cinema and children’s play. Two distinct current-gallery views add evening frontage and reception. Duplicate gallery scenes, green backgrounds, leaf graphics and generic people photographs are excluded. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Ten complete home sheets retain their original floor and unit keys. Numerical apartment areas are absent. Type 7 shows no private pool. The Type 4 and Type 5 keys repeat unit numbers despite different drawings. Confirm the applicable approved plan, configuration and contractual area with SAMANA. All ten complete physical pages 30–39 were individually reviewed. The two studio, six pool-equipped one-bedroom, one non-pool one-bedroom and two-bedroom drawings remain separately selectable. Types 4 and 5 repeat the same printed unit lists despite different position shading and geometry. Type 6 retains the printed unit 464 without silently changing it. No numerical area is inferred from room dimensions or broad category claims. Convertible notes require approved-configuration confirmation.
review.location: The complete original portfolio map on brochure page 27 and travel panel on page 28 were visually reviewed. Map label 43 identifies Imperial Garden. The first travel group differs between brochure and primary page, so the cards use the current primary range with an explicit note. The official q value 25.062934539664905, 55.231239212325654 is retained with source hash and six-place conversion. The pin remains project vicinity.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML and the original developer brochure retain receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. Native image origins, complete drawing notices and physical-page PDF links remain available. Protected ownership, completed commercial/text research and existing source qualifications are preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific apartment areas, resolution of repeated Type 4/5 unit lists and the Type 6 unit reference, contractual convertible-layout approval, final fitout, a verified entrance and dated construction photographs were not established.
